AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.

5. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

6. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.

7. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.

8. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

9. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.

10. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

13. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.

14. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
